2. Obtain and gather an acacia log.
3. Craft 4 acacia planks from 1 acacia log.
4. Obtain and gather 4 oak logs.

6. Craft 1 crafting table with 4 acacia planks.

This completes the crafting of the first crafting table needed to continue your puzzle.
